description:
Configure advanced shipping rules for the store. 

1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping classes.
2. Create two new shipping classes:
   - Name: "Bulky Items", Slug: "bulky-items", Description: "Large or heavy items requiring special shipping handling"
   - Name: "Fragile", Slug: "fragile", Description: "Delicate items requiring careful packaging"

3. Go to Shipping zones > Domestic > Flat rate (click Edit).
4. Configure the Shipping Class Costs:
   - "Bulky Items" shipping class cost: $15.00
   - "Fragile" shipping class cost: $8.00
   - "No shipping class" cost: $5.00
   - Save settings.

5. Assign these classes to products:
   - Edit product "Wireless Bluetooth Headphones" (SKU: WBH-001) and assign it the "Fragile" shipping class.
   - Edit product "Merino Wool Sweater" (SKU: MWS-GRY-L) and assign it the "Bulky Items" shipping class.
   - Update both products.
